title: SOS: burst allowance of 2 in rate limiter
description: Gap 2 of a6qg: spec 18.4.1 'Burst allowance: 2' unimplemented. SosResource.check_rate_limit (python/src/lichen/coap/resources/emergency.py) applies the 600s cooldown to every repeat, so a second SOS at +1s is rejected where spec permits. Implement burst semantics per vector cooldown_resets_on_accept (accepts at t=0 and t=1000ms; accept at t=600000; reject at t=601000). Flip xfail(strict) test_burst_second_accepted_exact_pin; update green doc test test_burst_second_rejected_live_behavior.
